The Resolution Chamber: A Vortex Therapy Immersion

THE RESOLUTION CHAMBER: A Vortex Therapy Immersion, an intimate encounter with Truth.

An Exclusive VortexHealing® Group Healing | Limited to 5 Participants (Online)

Most of the time, we focus on clearing an issue. This experience is different. This is about resolution. I am opening a rare, high-frequency container for just five individuals to engage in Vortex 10th Dimensional Therapy. This specialised transmission facilitates a direct, non-verbal dialogue between your personality's consciousness and the deepest layers of your being. It is an opportunity to lay bare your most persistent patterns and have them met by the vast intelligence of the Divine.

The Experience: A Dialogue of Truth
The transmission used to facilitate this healing (called Vortex Therapy) gets the personality's consciousness to engage and process the issue, like a dialogue with your own consciousness about the issues you have. It forces the issue to come to the surface and creates a process that helps it resolve.

What to expect during the session:

  • Active Engagement: Even without actual talking being involved, you'll feel that the issue is being confronted in your consciousness in a way that your consciousness is forced to respond.
  • Deep Emotional Integration: It brings up stuck places in your emotional consciousness, working them out through confrontation with Truth, so that you will meet, confront, and engage with your core issues.
  • Multi-Dimensional Transformation: This isn't a surface-level shift; the process is designed to permeate every layer of your existence. Everything will be transformed all the way to the 10th Dimension.

Why the 5-Person Limit?
Because of the intensity and precision of Vortex Therapy, this container is intentionally kept small. This ensures a concentrated field where your specific stuck places receive the energetic focus required for a true breakthrough.

This is for the seeker who is ready to stop managing their issues and start resolving them at the root.
Are you ready to meet yourself in the light of Truth?

The Nervous System Map for Being Received

Most of us consciously long to be deeply seen, heard and supported. Yet if our nervous system experienced early misattunement, childhood instability, or later abuse and relational trauma, the body learns a painful survival rule: exposure equals peril. When someone offers us true presence, care or open-hearted reception, an un-attuned nervous system doesn't feel safety — it feels an audit, a threat, or an impending trap. This powerful 4-session VortexHealing® series is designed to untangle these survival patterns at the root, shift out of defensive armour, and rebuild your somatic capacity to safely be received. A nervous system map for being received describes the ventral vagal state of safety and connection — where your body realises it is welcomed, heard and held safely, acting as the biological home of co-regulation where defences drop and relaxation begins.

The three states we work with: Ventral Vagal (Safety & Connection) — calm heart rate, steady breath, soft facial muscles, relaxed belly, natural voice; the biological home of co-regulation where defences drop and you feel warmly welcomed. Sympathetic (Fight or Flight) — racing thoughts, hyper-vigilance, urge to defend or fix; activated when you feel unseen, misunderstood or threatened. Dorsal Vagal (Shutdown) — physical heaviness, numbness, feeling invisible and unable to absorb care; activated when connection fails completely.

About Mara

Highest level of VortexHealing® training Top Practitioner 2024 ZenPass London Holistic Wellness Leaders Top rated Treatwell Salon 2022 & 2023 Host of Seekers of Grace

Mara is a registered VortexHealing® practitioner with the highest level of training. She is the host of Seekers of Grace on News For The Soul, syndicated on NBC Radio KCAA.

VortexHealing® is a powerful holistic system of multi-dimensional healing and inner awakening which works solely with divine light and consciousness. It derives its name from a particular divine energy vortex that is brought in through the heart and which becomes a vehicle for divine presence to manifest healing and transformation.

The deep connection to this divine presence is what makes VortexHealing® so unique, for the beginning practitioner can channel not just very powerful healing energies — the 49 unique forms of divine Vortex Light — but also the consciousness of the divine presence itself, and have all that be bridged deeply into whomever is being treated.

This enables VortexHealing® to perform extraordinary healings on the physical and emotional level as well as to release the deepest karmic issues we hold as human beings. They are transformed directly by divine consciousness, at all levels of our energy system and consciousness. At the same time, we are dropped deeper into our alignment with Divine and True Self.

Questions

What can I expect during a session?

Both in-person and remote sessions start with an initial consultation, to make sure your healing is customised to your needs. We will have a chat, and also — with your consent — I will tune in and use my psychic sensing to see what is coming up for you in terms of what your energy system needs and your most significant issues, whether karmic, emotional or psychological.

Every VortexHealing® session is different. There are a great many possibilities: specific protocols for emotional issues, work on the energy system and the physical body, clearing the deepest karmic layers, relaxation, work on organs, genetics, infection protocols to clear viruses and pathogens, relationship healings, and special projects. The Divine presence that is the source of all the grace and healing power of VortexHealing® is what guides the healing.

VortexHealing® is a very powerful healing art, so it is to be expected that various situations can arise from receiving it. Certain problems, either physical or emotional, may be alleviated. Deep mystical experiences can occur, as well as life-changing realisations. But sometimes suppressed emotions and physical tensions receive enough healing to be pushed to the surface, so that they can be released or resolved, and this process may create various emotional or physical symptoms. Deep healing is a process intended to create changes in your life, and those changes can manifest physically, emotionally and spiritually. It is all part of the healing process.

For healings done in person at my studio, you will lie down comfortably on a massage bed. The light will be soft — off, or adjustable if you prefer — with candles placed around the room to make the atmosphere cosy and relaxing. I also use essential oils and warm compresses, in accordance with your medical history and any conditions, to add an extra touch of relaxation. That part is entirely optional and not part of the VortexHealing® session itself.

How should I prepare for my session?

There is nothing in particular you have to do. Arriving hydrated is a good thing, and comfortable clothes will help you unwind.

Strictly no intoxicated clients will be allowed to proceed with the healing, and no refund will be given if you are found to be under the influence of recreational drugs or alcohol.

Children and minors under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, who will be present for the entire duration of the healing.

Please ensure you can make some time to relax after your session. VortexHealing® is a very powerful healing art. Therefore, it is to be expected that various situations can arise from receiving this healing art. Certain problems, either physical or emotional, may be alleviated. Deep mystical experiences can occur, as well as life-changing realisations. But sometimes, suppressed emotions and physical tensions may receive enough healing to be pushed to the surface, so that they can be released or resolved, and this process may create various emotional or physical symptoms. Deep healing is a process that is intended to create changes in one's life, and those changes can manifest physically, emotionally and spiritually. It is all part of the healing process.

Is the session safe for everyone?

VortexHealing® is guided by Divine Intelligence and it will work wherever is most beneficial for you. This means it can never harm you in any way, and it cannot be corrupted. It is safe for everyone — including your beloved pets.

Generally, VortexHealing® GENETICS work is not carried out on pregnant women until the third month of pregnancy, or on children below the age of seven. Do send me an email or a message to check individual situations.

What is VortexHealing® Divine Magic Healing?

VortexHealing® is a powerful, holistic system of multi-dimensional healing from the Merlin lineage, which works solely with divine light and consciousness. It derives its name from a particular divine energy vortex that is brought in through the heart and which becomes a vehicle for divine presence to manifest healing and transformation.

The deep connection to this divine presence is what makes VortexHealing® so unique, for the beginning practitioner can channel not just very powerful healing energies — the 49 unique forms of divine Vortex Light — but also the consciousness of the divine presence itself, and have all that be bridged deeply into whomever is being treated.

This enables VortexHealing® to perform extraordinary healings on the physical and emotional level as well as to release the deepest karmic issues we hold as human beings. They are transformed directly by divine consciousness, at all levels of our energy system and consciousness. At the same time, we are dropped deeper into our alignment with Divine and True Self.

All VortexHealings® are guided by the divine intelligence within the Vortex. This divine presence, which is the source of all the grace and healing power of this lineage, refers to itself by the name "Merlin", which is why this is called the Merlin lineage. The Merlin of the Arthurian legend was one of the human teachers of this lineage.

The view of VortexHealing® is that all of life is One — One Source, One Consciousness, One Divinity — expressing Itself as this amazing experience of creation. But our basic experience of life is that of being separate from everything else, which creates all kinds of issues and false identities that, over time and lives, imprint or condition every level of our human system, and generate suffering. This web of conditioning is almost unimaginably deep, completely distorting our experience of being human. It creates all kinds of emotional issues, mental attitudes, and blockages in our human energy system, which ultimately generates weakness and physical disease.

The intent of VortexHealing® is to release this conditioning on every level it is found, returning the person to emotional balance and energetic strength, so that health prevails. But the goal of VortexHealing® is also much larger than this. It is designed to create enough inner space from the webs of personal conditioning, and enough self-awareness, that we can begin to awaken out of our conditioned web of reality to the freedom and Oneness that is our true nature.

What is Relationship Healing & Breakups?

Interaction between people is interwoven in the astral realm, and over time the emotional positionality expressed by each person builds up, and the person starts to interact with that built-up position instead of directly with the other person.

This field exists also on a personal karmic level, and on a general Universal Consciousness level that holds all personal interconnections of karmic cause and effect from the beginning of each being's personal history, and between two ancestral genetic lines on a karmic level. VortexHealing® can clear your interactions from this build-up, and so much more.

We have relationships with individual people, with our jobs, food, exercise and so on, and with life in general. After a breakup, people are still very much intertwined energetically and in consciousness, which can be confusing and prevent them from moving on with their life.

You do not need to acknowledge the other person if you wish to receive a relationship healing. Couples can also attend the session together if they wish — the price shown when you book is the total price, not per person.

What is Space Clearing | Entities & Ghost Release?

The astral realm interpenetrates all of our familiar four-dimensional space-time world dimensions. Everything we think, feel and build leaves an impression, a remark on the astral plane.

Over time, the building up of emotional charge in a place can make the space feel heavy, uncomfortable and stiff. You may find yourself not at ease or emotionally overwhelmed, and tensions in the interaction between people in a given environment can seem to arise for apparently no reason.

Furthermore, when the tissue that separates our realm from the astral realm gets torn, beings from higher dimensions can permeate our field of consciousness, influencing our reality. Enough emotional pain, trauma, or a focused emotional negativity can cause this kind of energetic opening, leaving open access for those energies to come through and get attached to someone, or to something like an object, a place or a building.

As an advanced VortexHealing® practitioner trained at the highest level, Mara can quickly and efficiently clear accumulated emotional imprints, as well as clearing a person's system, an object, a building or a house of other-dimensional energies and beings, and seal the ruptures in the astral — even at distance. Mara specialises in entity removal, space clearings and spirit possession cases.

Ghosts inhabit places, and sometimes they can start interfering with the living and create strange happenings. Ghosts aren't what we are used to thinking they are — they are not lost souls that did not cross over the right way. Ghosts are leftover pieces of the emotional body of a departed person, one of our seven energetic bodies, which with enough emotional energy of attachment to something or someone on the Earth will somehow create a cohesion, and their human-like form is kept.

Spirits and ghosts are quickly and effectively released from a place, even at distance, and harmony and balance can be restored.
